title: Great mens cologne scent.
text: Great mens cologne scent.. I really enjoy the names on these candles. This one, Tinder also says " single but not sorry" lol, but I think its because the scent smells like a nice mans cologne( to me). Its a sexy musky scent that smells like an expensive cologne. It is boxed well with a liner inside as well. It is in a fairly thick glass container that is just a bit bigger than a soda can. I really like the scent because I do NOT like anything that is a "flavor" scent like vanilla, pumpkin spice etc. yuk. This  gives off a subtle scent unlit and just sitting on a table. When lit, it takes about 15 or so mins to smell it in the room. It is also not strong, but subtle even then. I really like it.
